ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA)
After arguing the matter at length, learned counsel Sri Shriharsha R. Harwal for the petitioner files a memo.

Memo reads as under:
"It is most humbly prayed that the hon'ble Court may be pleased to permit the petitioner to withdraw the petition with liberty to file fresh NC: 2025:KHC-K:2778 HC-KAR bail petition after examination CW-11 witness, in the interest of justice."
Placing the memo on record, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
